title: Kabul residents publicly seek action on teacher shortage
location: Kabul, residents of districts 6 and 13; press-conference venue not reported
scope: Single reported press conference in Kabul
participants_original: Attendance not reported; 8AM describes residents from two districts holding a press conference.
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance number or clear crowd-size description is reported. Public press conference and district representation alone do not establish 50 participants.

start_date.summary: 8AM dates the press conference to 17 October 2020.

end_date.summary: No end date or duration is reported.

location.summary: Residents from Kabul districts 6 and 13 held the press conference; exact venue not reported.

scope.summary: One press conference is described; no evidence of a multi-location campaign.

organizer.summary: Participants are described as residents; no organizer named.

state_target.summary: Residents asked the acting Afghan education minister to address teacher shortages in local schools.

demands.summary: Request sought resolution of teacher shortages; classified as labor_wage_dispute for review.

threshold_50.summary: No numeric or qualitative evidence establishes 50 participants.

state_response.summary: The Ministry of Education said it would address the shortage by hiring contract teachers; accommodation is coded yes as a reported promise.

notes: The account describes a public press conference and a demand to the education minister, but does not establish that 50 or more people were present. Ministry response is a reported promise, not evidence of implementation.
open_questions: How many people attended?
Was this a protest gathering within the codebook threshold?

title: Kabul protest against planned Najibullah memorial
location: Outside the Grand Loya Jirga tent, Kabul
scope: One counter-demonstration concerning a planned memorial
organizer: Members and supporters of a council of jihadi groups, political parties and civil society organizations
threshold_50_evidence: Pajhwok reports roughly 2,000 participants, clearly above the threshold.

start_date.summary: Pajhwok dates the gathering to 1 October 2020.

location.summary: Outside Kabul's Grand Loya Jirga tent.

scope.summary: One protest against a planned memorial.

organizer.summary: Participants were members and supporters of a named council of jihadi, political, and civil-society groups.

state_target.summary: The gathering opposed the memorial and vowed to prevent it; the report says the government had already blocked the ceremony after earlier objections, but does not establish whether this gathering demanded government action.

demands.summary: Participants opposed the planned memorial and chanted against communism; the precise target of the demand is unclear.

state_response.summary: The report says the government had already blocked the memorial after earlier objections; it does not connect that prior decision to this day's gathering or report later response.

notes: Counter-rally/support-action review is needed. The crowd size is clear, but the current gathering may have targeted event organizers rather than Afghan government policy. Do not infer that the government ban was a response to this gathering.
open_questions: Was the gathering asking the Afghan government to prohibit the memorial, or directing its opposition to organizers?
Was the earlier government decision related to this specific crowd?

title: Herat residents ask negotiators to preserve ANDSF in peace talks
location: Mawlana Jalaluddin Mohammad Balkhi Hall, Herat
scope: Single reported Herat gathering; national multi-location scope not established
participants_original: Almost 1,000 residents, according to Salaam Times.
threshold_50_evidence: The source reports almost 1,000 attendees, clearly above 50.

start_date.summary: Salaam Times dates this gathering to 11 October 2020.

location.summary: Mawlana Jalaluddin Mohammad Balkhi Hall, Herat.

scope.summary: One Herat gathering is described separately from another Herat demonstration the same day.

state_target.summary: Participants asked Afghan peace negotiators to preserve Afghan security forces in the peace process.

demands.summary: Demand concerns Afghan government negotiating policy on the future of the ANDSF.

notes: This is explicitly separate from a second Herat ceasefire gathering on the same date. Although the action supports retaining state security forces, participants make a direct demand of Afghan government negotiators about policy; retain for manual review rather than exclude as support-only.
open_questions: Is this support action treated as a qualifying demand on government policy under the original coding practice?
Did any authorities respond?

participants_original: More than 500 residents and religious scholars, according to Salaam Times.
threshold_50_evidence: The report says more than 500 people attended.

start_date.summary: Salaam Times dates this separate demonstration to 11 October 2020.

scope.summary: A separate demonstration from the same-day gathering urging preservation of ANDSF.

organizer.summary: Organizer unknown; religious scholars are among attendees.

state_target.summary: Participants called on Afghanistan's government and the Taliban to declare a ceasefire and continue peace talks.

demands.summary: Demand for ceasefire and continuation of peace talks.

notes: Salaam Times expressly reports this as a separate gathering from the same-day ANDSF demonstration. The request addresses both the Afghan government and Taliban.
open_questions: Did the demonstration continue beyond 11 October?
Was there any government response?

location: Jalalabad, Nangarhar; exact venue not reported
scope: One brief retrospective mention of a local demonstration
participants_original: Attendance not reported; Salaam Times calls it a demonstration similar to those in Herat.
threshold_50_evidence: The report gives no attendance estimate. The event is described as a demonstration, but 50 participants are not established.

start_date.summary: Salaam Times dates the Jalalabad demonstration to 10 October 2020.

scope.summary: A separate Jalalabad demonstration, briefly mentioned as similar to the Herat actions.

state_target.summary: Described in the context of calls for ceasefire and continued peace talks, but the short mention does not detail the target.

demands.summary: Peace/ceasefire context; exact demands are not separately given for this demonstration.

threshold_50.summary: No crowd estimate; threshold remains unresolved.

notes: Only a brief mention in the Herat report; preserve as a separate event lead and do not transfer the Herat attendance count to Jalalabad.

title: Kabul demonstrators demand Afghan diplomatic action against France
location: Deh Afghanan, central Kabul; EslahtOnline also identifies Kabul province
scope: One Kabul gathering; relationship to parallel Herat action is unresolved
organizer: Unknown; no organizer identified in the dated accounts
participants_original: Anadolu reports thousands collectively across Kabul and Herat without allocating numbers; TOLOnews describes a large number in Kabul; EslahtOnline gives no crowd count.
threshold_50_evidence: TOLOnews describes a large number of Kabul residents; Anadolu's collective estimate for Kabul and Herat is in the thousands but not apportioned by city. Likely above 50, but city-specific threshold evidence is not precise enough to close without review.

start_date.summary: Anadolu dates Kabul and Herat demonstrations to 30 October; EslahtOnline's resolution is dated 30 October. TOLOnews says Friday but its rendering lacks a calendar date.

end_date.summary: Anadolu says the protest concluded with symbolic burning, but no clock-time or later continuity is reported.

location.summary: Anadolu places Kabul residents at Deh Afghanan; EslahtOnline identifies the public gathering as in Kabul province.

scope.summary: Kabul is documented separately from the Herat gathering; possible relationship between accounts of same-day Kabul action requires review.

organizer.summary: No organizer is identified in the accessible reports.

state_target.summary: Kabul demonstrators and the written resolution ask Afghanistan's government to take diplomatic action against France, including ending/suspending relations and expelling or recalling diplomatic representatives.

demands.summary: Demand for Afghan government diplomatic/legal action against France and suspension or severance of relations; additional boycott request is directed at traders and consumers.

participants.summary: Anadolu reports thousands collectively in Kabul and Herat, without city apportionment; TOLOnews says a large number in Kabul; EslahtOnline gives no count.

threshold_50.summary: Qualitative large-crowd wording supports but does not precisely establish the Kabul-only threshold; Anadolu's number is shared across two cities.

protester_violence.summary: Anadolu says images/flags were burned. This does not establish violence against persons; no such violence is reported.

state_response.summary: No Afghan government response to the demonstration is reported.

notes: Own-government foreign-policy demand qualifies for review despite the trigger being remarks by France's president. Treat Kabul as its own event pending scope review; do not attribute the shared Kabul/Herat attendance estimate to Kabul alone. TOLOnews lacks a displayed publication date and may describe the same Kabul gathering, but that match is not established.
open_questions: Can Kabul's attendance independently be confirmed as at least 50?
Does TOLOnews describe this same 30 October action?
Were the Kabul and Herat actions coordinated as one national episode or separate local events?
Did Afghan authorities respond?

end_date.summary: No end date or duration is reported.

location.summary: At the provincial council building in Jalalabad.

scope.summary: One local Jalalabad demonstration is reported.

organizer.summary: Eastern Zone National Youth Union is named as organizer.

state_target.summary: Participants ask Afghanistan's government to cut political, trade and diplomatic relations with France.

demands.summary: Demand for Afghanistan to sever multiple forms of relations with France.

participants.summary: Hundreds of youth and residents reported.

protester_violence.summary: Pars Today describes the demonstration as peaceful.

state_response.summary: No Afghan government response is reported.

notes: Although the trigger concerned a foreign president, the reported demand is explicitly directed at Afghanistan's own government's foreign policy. A separate 30 October Rodat gathering is mentioned without a turnout estimate and is not merged here.
open_questions: Was there any Afghan government response?
Did this local gathering continue after 31 October?
